key_insight: QAOA’s sensitivity to noise depends strongly on its variational parameters, and this dependence can be bounded analytically to guide more noise-resilient circuit choices.
engineering_relevance: The result helps practitioners select and optimize QAOA parameters and search strategies that are more robust on noisy near-term quantum hardware.
method: Derive an upper bound on total variation distance between noisy and noiseless QAOA outputs under a Pauli noise model.
Use noisy simulations to validate the parameter-dependent bound and compare parameter-generation strategies.
Introduce optimization approaches with error penalties and truncated search, and extend the analysis to the quantum adiabatic algorithm via the continuous limit.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that noisy simulation results support the analytic bound and provide guidance for choosing parameter-generation methods under noise.
watch_item: The bound and resilience strategies are derived for a specific Pauli noise model, so their effectiveness may vary under more realistic or hardware-specific noise processes.
paper_title: Parameter-Dependent Noise Resilience in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
